name: Empty Dolphin 52
author: 2Fl00rian6
description: Sky-blue button that changes colour on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes 1px solid #1457f4, background-color changes from #1457f4 to transparent, text color changes from #fff to #1457f4. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 0px 5px #1457f4, 0px 0px 0px 10px #1457f4, the outline is removed.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Empty Dolphin 52</title>
<style>
/* Empty Dolphin 52 by 2Fl00rian6 — https://uiverse.io/2Fl00rian6/empty-dolphin-52 */
button {
 background-color: rgb(20, 87, 244);
 border: 1px solid rgb(20, 87, 244);
 padding: 12px 20px;
 border-radius: 7px;
 transition: .3s;
 color: #fff;
}

button:hover {
 border: 1px solid rgb(20, 87, 244);
 background-color: transparent;
 color: rgb(20, 87, 244);
}

button:focus {
 box-shadow: 0px 0px 0px 5px rgba(20, 87, 244, 0.37), 0px 0px 0px 10px rgba(20, 87, 244, 0.38);
 outline: none;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>This is a button :)</button>

</body>
</html>
